scripts.dev: pnpm db:migrate && concurrently -k -n api,web 'pnpm dev:api' 'pnpm dev:web'
scripts.typecheck: tsc -p tsconfig.web.json --noEmit && tsc -p tsconfig.api.json --noEmit && tsc -p tsconfig.jobs.json --noEmit && tsc -p tsconfig.icon.json --noEmit && tsc -p tsconfig.tests.json --noEmit
scripts.check: pnpm typecheck && pnpm test && pnpm test:integration && pnpm test:background && pnpm build && pnpm build:worker
scripts.db:migrate: wrangler d1 migrations apply DB --local --config wrangler.local.jsonc
scripts.cf:types: wrangler types types/runtime.d.ts --config wrangler.jsonc --include-env=false && wrangler types apps/api/worker-configuration.d.ts --config wrangler.jsonc --env-interface ApiBindings --include-runtime=false --strict-vars=false && wrangler types apps/jobs/worker-configuration.d.ts --config apps/jobs/wrangler.jsonc --env-interface JobsBindings --include-runtime=false --strict-vars=false && wrangler types apps/icon-fetcher/worker-configuration.d.ts --config apps/icon-fetcher/wrangler.jsonc --env-interface IconBindings --include-runtime=false --strict-vars=false
scripts.db:migrate:remote: wrangler d1 migrations apply DB --remote --config wrangler.jsonc
